difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y formally smooth over S, the canonical sequence 0 -> f^*Omega_{Y/S} -> Omega_{X/S} -> Omega_{X/Y} -> 0 of Morphisms, lemma triangle-differentials is short exact. The retained proof writes the algebraic equivalent in full — for A -> B -> C with B -> C formally smooth the sequence 0 -> C (x)_B Omega_{B/A} -> Omega_{C/A} -> Omega_{C/B} -> 0 of Algebra, lemma exact-sequence-differentials is exact — and closes it by the named algebra lemma (Algebra, lemma ses-formally-smooth); the scheme sequence is obtained by gluing these affine identifications. Retained author proof at lines 3429-3440.
